label: PROPER_PART_EXTENSIONALITY_1: unrestricted identity on a fixed partial order
paraphrase: OPEN analyst principle on a supplied Type B with a supplied PartialOrder B: for all x and y in B, equality of their strict proper-part profiles implies x=y, including minimal objects. It asserts no carrier population, actuality, modal status or extra metaphysical simplicity. Strong sibling of the composite-restricted principle on EXACTLY the same B/order; no implicit quantification over different domains or orders.
